{{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Nightmarish Hulk''' was a fast and tanky enemy that appeared in [[The Nightmare Realm]] and [[Containment]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had a high amount of health, higher than the [[Rotting Terror]] but lower than the [[Conjurer (Hexscape)|Conjurer]], while also being quite fast. It also had [[Stun Immunity]], making it immune to being knocked back, while also making it only get slowed down by stuns. On some waves, it could spawn with the [[Bloated]] attribute. ==Appearance== The '''Nightmarish Hulk''' was a three-headed entity with light maroon skin. Its heads had visible necks, two neon red eyes and three horns at the front. It wore light brown pants, grey shoulder-pads and a grey chestplate. It also had brown and red armbands. It stumbled around the path while it walked. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers such as the [[Ranger]], [[Gatling Gun]], [[Engineer]] and [[Minigunner]] are strongly recommended to kill the '''Nightmarish Hulk''' *Because of its immunities, it could not be knocked back and it would only be slowed down instead of being stunned by stunning towers. **While not immune to freeze, its large size would make them freeze it for a shorter amount of time compared to a average-sized enemy. **Other forms of stalling, such as the [[DJ Booth]]'s slowdown are not affected, though the [[DJ Booth]] will not be able to knock it back. *The '''Nightmarish Hulk''' had quite high defense. Because of this, defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Freezer]] or [[DJ Booth]] were be useful against it. ==Update History== *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0]] **'''Nightmarish Hulk''' added. **{{Bug}} Poison and electric defense dropping does not decrease '''Nightmarish Hulk's''' defense. *'''30 October 2024''' - [[v1.39.0]] **'''Nightmarish Hulk''' now appears in [[Containment]]. *'''6 November 2024''' - [[v1.40.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Poison and electric defense dropping now drops '''Nightmarish Hulk's''' defense, though the [[Jester]] still cannot drop it. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Nightmarish Hulk''' removed. {{TheNightmareRealm|[[Conjurer (Hexscape)|Conjurer]]|Wave 12|Nightmarish Hulk|Wave 13|[[Hex's Maw]]|Wave 16}} {{Containment|[[Hex Drako]]|Wave 19|[[Corrupted Titus]] & Nightmarish Hulk|Wave 20|[[Hex Weaver]]|Wave 22}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
